edges.subject: PPT1
edges.quote: CLN1 disease (neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis type 1) is a rare, genetic, neurodegenerative lysosomal storage disorder caused by palmitoyl-protein thioesterase 1 (PPT1) enzyme deficiency.

edges.subject: CLN1 disease
edges.quote: Clinical features include developmental delay, psychomotor regression, seizures, ataxia, movement disorders, visual impairment, and early death.
